name: Seating chart
desc: Upload your attendance classes.csv (then pick a class) or any .xlsx/.csv class list, seat each name on a desk of the classroom plan (lock some students, shuffle the rest), save the plan for next time, and download it as an A4 PDF. Names stay in your browser.

name: Class Tracker
desc: Open your school folder of class files, then take attendance, print catch-up slips, track book work, LSQ and assessment results, and log N-awards. Names stay on your computer.
